title: Why Nobody Wants To Answer The Phone Anymore
hook: Why won't anyone answer your call?
closing: Just text next time. Everyone will thank you.
question: Caller or texter? Tell me below.

segments.say: Most young adults now say they'd rather get a text than a phone call, 70 percent of them.
About 44 percent of young adults say they genuinely dread making phone calls.
37 percent of young adults would rather send a voice note than make a call.
